# Eloré Consulting

> A Miami-based AI strategy and implementation consultancy. We help businesses put AI to work — training teams, embedding as a fractional AI product manager, and building custom AI tools. We implement alongside clients rather than just advising, with results measured in weeks.

## What we do
- AI Foundations & Workflow Integration — hands-on team training plus wiring AI tools (Claude, Lindy) into existing workflows.
- Fractional AI Product Manager — embedded, senior AI leadership that maps opportunities and ships the roadmap.
- Custom AI Development — RAG over your data, agents on top of your ERP/CRM, and internal tools (product-managed end to end).

## Who we serve
We focus on four verticals we've operated in first-hand — manufacturing, direct-to-consumer / e-commerce, marketing (including agentic SEO & AEO), and home services — and also work with entertainment & content, private equity, product businesses, and small & medium businesses generally. Primarily Miami / South Florida and across the US.
